jobs.detail: THREE equal side-by-side panels KETTLEBELL DOUBLE PUSH PRESS. Same FRONT three-quarter view, feet shoulder-width flat and same places throughout. Exactly TWO matching gray kettlebells per panel, each arched handle securely enclosed by one hand, round mass outside/back of forearm. LEFT upright standing with both bells at shoulder-height rack, elbows bent underneath load, wrists neutral. MIDDLE shallow vertical knee/hip DIP about 15-25 degrees, knees track toes, torso upright and pelvis neutral, both bells REMAIN at shoulder rack. RIGHT drive legs straight and extend BOTH arms overhead in scapular plane, wrists/elbows stack over shoulders, knees/hips fully extended, no re-dip catch and no back arch. Round bells behind/outside forearms, handles connected, no floating weights or changed grip. PRIMARY DELTOIDS exposed red at both shoulder caps all phases; all other muscle regions gray, chest shirt pureblack. No squat-depth dip, no split stance, no arm-first jerk; show rack-dip-standing-overhead sequence.
